title: Route OCR provenance to Learn, Ask, Practice and Build with protected scoring
baseCommit: 0e79ddbc (KAN-205 VMM-33 head; composes VOCR-01 structural results)
whatBuilt: ONLY REVIEWED OCR ROUTES: raw perception refused; routing requires a REVIEWED result (owner-reviewed or correction-backed)
EXACT VERSIONS SURVIVE: every routed payload pins the exact page/region counts + source version + source revision; downstream surfaces never silently see newer versions
WRONG OPERATOR REFUSED: only the upload owner (or an authorized reviewer) may route; cross-operator rejected
STALE TRANSCRIPT REFUSED: source revision moved past the capture version -> routing refused; a stale transcript cannot silently affect assessment
NO NEW COMPETING SOURCE STORE: routed payloads REFERENCE the existing source contract (sourceVersion pinned); the router persists NO text as a source and exposes no source-store API (contract-proven)
CORRECTIONS route as corrections (bound to the original transcript via correctionSeq), never as new content
SURFACES: learn/ask/practice/build; build never receives answer keys (hiddenAnswerKeys: [])
